title: Time Jump to 16:05: Food-Booth Sighting Cleared, AMBER Review Due

fields.narration: It is now 16:05 on Saturday, two hours after the first 911 call. Lily is still missing. At 15:52 the food-booth caller from 14:16 called Console 2 back. She now says the girl she saw was 'maybe eight or nine' and was holding hands with a woman in a red hat. That sighting no longer points away from the north gate. Investigations has the parking volunteer's photo, IMG_5126.HEIC, with phone metadata of 13:51:22. It also has three colours from witnesses: dark, dark blue and primer gray. Deschutes County's six deputies and their search coordinator are checking in at the backup staging area in the Alder Falls High School north lot. They are not at the fairgrounds, because the incident is there. Search and Rescue has 22 volunteers working the barns and the RV area with only one deputy as an escort. Sunset is at about 18:15. The 16:05 AMBER worksheet review is due now. The one-hour target from first report to decision passed at 15:00. Visitors are still leaving through the main and north gates.
worldState: Clock is 16:05, Saturday. CAD 26-081377 is two hours old. Lily, six years old in a purple jacket, is still missing.

Food-booth sighting closed out: the 15:52 call-back to Console 2 describes a girl of about eight or nine with a woman in a red hat. It is not Lily. Nothing in CAD now places her anywhere but the north gate.

Vehicle evidence on hand: photo IMG_5126.HEIC (13:51:22) shows an older full-size pickup with no canopy, a light-coloured toolbox across the bed and a plate that cannot be read, possibly Oregon green-tree. Witnesses gave three colours: dark, dark blue and primer gray. No make has been confirmed by investigators.
Unconfirmed vehicle descriptions are still circulating publicly: silver-gray Chevy and black Dodge toward Redmond from @GrandmaJudyAF, and a post naming a local man with a blue Ford.
LEDS missing-person entry: entered with the Child Abduction flag, read-back logged by Console 2 at 14:31.
OSP Northern Communications AMBER desk (555-0142) is waiting for one vehicle description, a direction of travel and a time window before any request.
Deschutes County Sheriff's Office: 6 deputies and a search coordinator are checking in at the Alder Falls High School north lot (backup staging). They are not yet assigned.
Wren County Search and Rescue: 22 volunteers are in the barns and the RV area with one deputy escort. Sunset is at about 18:15.
Two Wren County patrol deputies are still on the north gate road and the Highway 26 approach.
The 16:05 AMBER worksheet review is due now. The one-hour decision target passed at 15:00.
Festival visitors are still leaving through the main and north gates.
fields.facilitatorNote: Have all roles move straight to the 16:05 worksheet review. Watch whether the IC brings Undersheriff Calvin Okafor in by phone, whether INV produces one vehicle description from the photo and the witnesses, and whether COMMS confirms the LEDS/NCIC flag and read-back. Also watch whether the IC gives the SAR escort job to the arriving Deschutes deputies instead of pulling the north gate road and Highway 26 units off the vehicle search.

instructorNote: This card removes the last open alternative sighting, so the AMBER criteria now depend mainly on settling one vehicle description. Watch whether the review produces a documented decision with executive involvement, and whether the new mutual aid deputies cover the SAR escorts instead of the deputies on the vehicle search.
